notes.title: New Features
items: Sidebar filter consolidation: Files and Diffs merged into a single Other filter — All / Sessions / Other / Need Attention
Copy File Name in the file tree and open-tabs sidebar context menus

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Foreground process detection falls back to the kernel pty process group, so Need Attention still works with libghostty-spm 1.4.0

notes.title: New Features
items: Open Note command in the command palette jumps to the focused session's note

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Diamond marker only appears for sessions inside the working folder
Dismissing the command palette while editing a note restores focus to the note editor

notes.title: New Features
items: Working-folder sessions show a diamond marker in the sidebar and editor tabs

notes.title: New Features
items: Working Folder setting for the default startup directory
Rename Tab and Rename Tab Group from the command palette
pi agent icon in the sidebar

Closing a noted session brings it forward and reveals the note first

notes.title: Fixes

Fixed terminal link opening for file://, web, and bare paths

notes.title: New Features

Info panel cards for files and diffs
